name: Square keyframe
layout: Build a centered but asymmetric square scene. Give the concept device 45-60% of the visual weight and the character 20-35%. Use a clear foreground action and one supporting background cue, with safe space around every edge.
text_policy: Do not generate final body copy. Reserve one compact annotation area that can be filled by deterministic post-processing.
constraints: Use a square-native composition with balanced edge tension.
The character must interact with the concept device rather than pose beside it.
Keep the silhouette readable at thumbnail size.
Rotate action, gaze and position across adjacent images.
Do not include calls to action, codes, logos or watermarks.
